The mutant race is defined by inherent, often unpredictable, genetic or magical deviations, born from wild magic, ancient technologies, or cataclysms.

Mutant Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Mutants choose 1 physical ability and 1 mental ability score to increase by 2 on creation, as well as one ability score of their choice to decrease by 2.
  • Size: Mutants are Medium creatures.
  • Type: Mutants are Humanoid creatures with the mutant subtype.
  • Base Speed: Mutants have a base speed of 30 feet on land.
  • Languages: Mutants begin play speaking Common. Mutants with high Intelligence scores can choose from: Draconic, Dwarven, Elvaan, Galkan, Giant, Goblin, and Orc.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Variable Resistance: Mutants roll 1d6 on creation for a random elemental resistance 5.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Keen Senses: Mutants receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

Magical Racial Traits

  • Spell-Like Ability (Sp): Mutants can choose a 1st-level blue mage spell and cast it once per day as a spell-like ability.

Other Racial Traits

  • Variable Mutant Abilities: Mutants gain a random mutant ability by rolling 1d100 upon creation.
  • Variable Stats: At each level beyond 1st, a mutant gains a +1 bonus to a randomly determined ability score (replaces standard ability score increases at every 4th level).

Senses Racial Traits

  • Darkvision: Mutants can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.
  • Low-light Vision: A mutant can see twice as far as a hume in dim light.
